title: Performance Ad System
description: A four-image reference-dependent set that establishes one sports-equipment ad language across product hero, motion, materials, and athlete-pairing surfaces.
creative_direction: Image 01 defines the hero product, performance palette, material realism, and advertising grammar. Images 02-04 depend on that anchor while proving the same system across motion, cutaway, and athlete-pairing use cases.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-motion-surge-ad, 03-material-cutaway-board, 04-athlete-pairing-variant. Queue may run 02-motion-surge-ad, 03-material-cutaway-board, 04-athlete-pairing-variant concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
